answer: In this Proof of Agent design, identity verification binds each claimed node to a Wesolowski VDF: the prover must execute a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings, with every output depending on the preceding one, before returning a succinct proof. An attacker simulating clones cannot parallelize any dependency chain across GPUs, so each additional identity imposes a physical delay instead of yielding immediate multiplicity. The willow, grove, and vine labels provide no security; verified sequential work does.
